title: Case Study: CPI worked with FNBO to develop a co-branded card for a large customer
summary: CPI worked with FNBO to develop a co-branded card for a large customer. Learn more about the project in this case study.
body_markdown: In 2022, FNBO had a major opportunity to develop a co-branded card product with a large customer. That was during a time when the market was experiencing supply challenges affecting card production, and they contacted CPI to discuss their concerns. Learn more about how FNBO has come to think of the relationship with CPI as a partnership in this quick-read case study.
